tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nyams len spyi la nye bar mkho ba'i dogs dpyod som nyi sel byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ thub dbang rgyal tshab dam pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /'dzam gling rgyan drug rgyal ba gnyis pa sogs/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag btsal nas/ /thar 'dod nyams len nyer mkho cung zad bri/ /de yang byang chub lam rim sogs/ /mkhas pa'i gzhung nas 'byung ba las/ /lhag pa sger du su zhig gis/ /'chad par mi nus 'os min kyang*/ /dad ldan nan tan dbyu gu yis/ /bskul las blo gros rnga chen ngos/ /nyer mkho'i gtam gyi sgra brnyan ni/ /rang dgar 'dod pa tsam zhig bsgrag /rgyal ba nyid kyis sems can rnams/ /mos pa tha dad sna tshogs pa/ /gzigs nas theg pa rnam gsum dang*/ /theg pa sna tshogs dag kyang bstan/ /de phyir blo la bltos pas na/ / nyams su len tshul mtha' gcig tu/ /'di ni 'di ltar nges so zhes/ /gcig nyid kho nar bzhag par dka'/ /de yang mdo sngags so so dang*/ /zung 'brel nyams su len pa dang*/ /sngags la'ang gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs/ /re re 'am gsum ka nyams len gyis/ /mtshon te rnam pa du ma srid/ /'on kyang mchog dman bar ma'i rim/ /gang yin bstan pa spyi lugs dang*/ /mthun par go rim bzhin 'jug na/ /thog mar bstan pa'i 'jug sgo che/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro ba'i/ /skyabs 'gro nyid nas 'jug par rigs/ /gnas skabs mi mthun phyogs tsam las/ /rang nyid skyob pa'i ched du ni/ /skyabs su 'gro ba ma yin gyi/ /ngan song 'jig las skyob pa'i ched/ /skyabs su 'gro ba nyid la 'bad/ /ngan song sdug bsngal ma dran na/ /de las thar 'dod mi 'byung bas/ /de yi sdug bsngal shes nas ni/ /rgyud stong bsam pa gnad du che/ /de yang dmyal ba yi dwags dang*/ /dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal ji 'dra ba/ /yin tshul mdo rgyud bstan bcos las/ /bshad ltar nges na khyad par che/ /las nyon dbang gis bde 'gro dang*/ /ngan 'gro gang du skyes gyur kyang*/ /'du byed sdug bsngal gyis bcings pas/

/'khor ba nyid du skyes pa las/ /ma 'das de phyir 'khor ba ni/ /mchog dman gang yang don mi gnyer/ /de tshe gang du 'khor ba dang*/ /gang gis 'khor dang gang zhig 'khor/ /ji ltar 'khor sogs phyed dgos te/ /thams cad gcig tu 'khrul mi bya/ /skye rga na 'chis bsdus pa yi/ /'khor ba spyi las thar 'dod blo/ /ched du 'bad nas bskyed bya ste/ /bye brag ngan 'gro tsam nyid las/ /thar 'dod skyes kyang nges 'byung min/ /gang la 'khor ba spyi nyid las/ /thar 'dod shugs drag yod gyur na/ /de la thar pa don gnyer blo/ /nges par yod kyi gzhan du na/ /thar pa don du gnyer ro zhes/ / brjod kyang mtshan nyid tshang ba min/ /des na lha mi'i go 'phang tsam/ /don du gnyer ba mi rung yang*/ /sangs rgyas ma thob bar du ni/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i rten bzang po/ /thob phyir dge rtsa smon lam sogs/ /byed ma 'gal ba ci yang med/ /de yang thar pa don gnyer ba'i/ /zhar byung tsam du byed pa ste/ /dper na skom pas gdungs pa'i mis/ /don gnyer gtso bo btung ba ste/ /de yi ched du snod nyid kyang*/ /zhar la don du gnyer ba bzhin/ /zas gos don du gnyer ba tsam/ /'khor ba don du gnyer min te/ /dgra bcom dag la'ang zas gos sogs/ /don du gnyer ba yod pa bzhin/ /de ni gnas skabs lus 'tsho dang*/ /tsha grang ngo tsha'i gnas sogs las/ /skyob pa'i ched du dgos pas na/ /spang du rung pa'ang ma yin no/ /de phyir 'khor ba'i phun tshogs dag /don du mi gnyer gsungs gyur kyang*/ /sred par bcas pa yin min sogs/ /zhib cha yod pas 'khrul mi bya/ /ston pa dgra bcom 'khor dang bcas/ /grong du bsod snyoms la zhugs te/ /bsod snyoms dngos po gzhan phul sogs/ /bzhes pa yod phyir zang zing dngos/ /blangs tsam de nyid don gnyer min/ /bsod nams stobs ldan bsags mdzad pa'i/ /skyes chen zang zing 'byor med pa/ /srid kyang de nyid ma bzung ba/ /yin gyi dbul ba'i las kyis min/

/zang zing dngos po med pa dang*/ /don du mi gnyer gang zag kun/ /legs pa'i nges pa yod min te/ /yi dwags dud 'gro che phra bzhin/ /bsod nams mthu las byung ba yi/ / 'byor ldan gtong phod rab byung yang*/ /skyon min rgyal dbang paṇa chen bzhin/ / 'on kyang thar 'dod skyes bu ni/ /'dod chung chog shes che legs te/ /'tshol g.yeng bya byed mang ba ni/ /dge sbyong bar chad byed pa'i rgyu/ /bde 'gro ngan 'gros bsdus pa yi/ /'khor ba spyi las thar 'dod blo/ /skyes tsam nyid nas thar 'dod kyi/ /skyes bu yin mod de tsam gyis/ /mi chog rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyu/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bya/ /snying rje chen po med par ni/ /byang chub sems nyid mi skye bas/ /sdug bsngal can gyi sems can rnams/ /sdug bsngal las ni thar 'dod dang*/ /skyob par 'dod pa'i snying rje bskyed/ /sems can sdug bsngal rnam gsum las/ /skyob 'dod snying rje khyab che yang*/ /lhag par tshor ba sdug bsngal gyis/ /gzir ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas/ /rang gi thog tu len pa ni/ /phan yon che bar bshad pas na/ /de nyid yang yang goms par bya/ /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang*/ /ma 'dres bde la 'god 'dod pa'i/ /byams pa'i dmigs rnam rgya che yang*/ /lhag par bla med bde ba la/ / 'god 'dod sems pa mchog gsungs te/ /lhag bsam nyid kyang de ru 'dus/ / sems can thams cad rdzogs byang la/ /'god phyir rang nyid rdzogs byang chub/ / thob 'dod don gnyer khyad par can/ /skyes tshe byang chub sems nyid skyes/ / sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las/ /skyob 'dod bcos min ma skyes par/ /rdzogs byang thob 'dod don gnyer ba/ /skye ba srid mod sems de ni/ /rang don yid byed kho na'i dbang*/ /song phyir sems bskyed lta zhog gi / rdzogs byang don gnyer tshad ldan min/ /de phyir sems can don gyi phyir/ / rdzogs byang don du gnyer bar bya/

/bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba ni/ /yang dag rnyed pa tsam zhig ni/ /thar pa'i rgyu ru 'gro gsungs phyir/ /lta ba de ni btsal bya ste/ /de yang phra rags kun dang ni/ khyad par rang bzhin stong pa la/ /bya byed thams cad ches 'thad pa'i/ /lugs mchog thal 'gyur lta ba'i tshul/ /rje yi lugs bzhin dbu ma ltar/ /rigs pa'i rnam grangs mtha' yas sam/ /mdor bsdus yin yang rnam dag gi /phyogs su 'gro ba zhig btsal bya/ /de nyid zhi gnas dang 'brel bar/ /skyong rgyu byung na rab yin no/ /tshul de dka' bar nges pa ltar/ /ci nus 'jog cing dpyad sgom bya/ /de ltar dpyad cing bsgoms byas na/ /skad cig re re bzhin du yang*/ /thar pa'i bag chags 'jog mod kyi/ /bla med byang chub rgyu nyid du/ /'gro bar sangs rgyas don gnyer dang*/ /bsngo ba khyad par can gnyis kyis/ /zin pa la ltos de la 'bad/ /de nas phyin drug bslab gsum la/ /'jug phyir byang sdom bzung byas te/ /sbyin sogs spyod pa dag la bslab/ /sbyin pa dngos su gtong ba'am/ /yang na mdo dang lam rim nas/ / gsungs bzhin rang gi lus longs spyod/ /dge kun gzhan la gtong ba yi/ / 'phen pa yang yang dran par bya/ /so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi/ /sdom gsum srung ba tshul khrims te/ /bzod pa'i dbye ba spyi dang ni/ khyad par chos la nges sems kyi/ /bzod pa 'jug bya chos kyi phyir/ /dka' ba dang blangs bzod la 'bad/ /chos phyir brtson 'grus la 'jug cing*/ /dge ba'i dmigs pa gang yin pa/ /skabs su bab pa yun ring thung*/ /blo dang 'tshams pa nyid du bzhag /de dag la ni tshul bzhin du/ /dpyod pa'i shes rab rgyas bya zhing*/ khyad par yang dag don nyid la/ /rang gi blo dang bstun nas dpyod/ /sdom pa gsum po gang rung la/ /gnas tshe tshul khrims bslab 'byung zhing*/ /de la brten nas zhi gnas sam/ /de dang rjes mthun yang dag don/ /ci ltar rigs par mnyam bzhag bya/ /lhag mthong dgos sam rjes mthun pa'i/

/bdag med phra rags rtogs pa yi/ /lta ba ci rigs btsal byas te/ /shes rab bslab la 'jug par bya/ /de ltar phar phyin theg pa la/ /rang gi blo dang 'tsham par ni/ /bslabs des rdo rje theg pa'i lam/ /mchog tu mthong nas 'jug par bya/ /rje yi rtogs pa brjod pa las/ /mkhas gang sangs rgyas nyid las kyang*/ /dkon pa'i rdo rje theg pa la/ /rang dgar mthong nas mi 'jug pa/ /de ni blun po nyid du bshad/ /rje yi gsung 'bum thor bu'i mjug /'jam dbyangs gsung gi man ngag mchog /bkod par rigs lam la zhen te/ /gsang sngags lam 'dir mi 'jug pa/ /gang de sangs rgyas myur thob pa'i/ /skal chad can du bshad par mthong*/ /gal te gsang sngags la zhugs nas/ /dam tshig sdom pa bsrung dka' zhing*/ /dam tshig nyams na ngan 'gro ru/ /skye ba'i nyes par 'gyur gsungs dang*/ khyad par sngags la 'jug pa'i tshe/ /phar phyin theg pa'i lam gyis ni/ /rgyud smin byas pa dgos so zhes/ /gsungs phyir de 'dra dka' ba ru/ /mthong bas gsang sngags theg pa la/ /'jug par mi 'dod khyad par ru/ /gsang bde 'jigs sogs mngon rtogs kyang*/ /rnal 'byor byed par mi nus so/ /snyam na de ni thos nyung gis/ /phyogs tsam mthong ba'i log rtog ste/ /'o na so thar sdom pa kun/ /len tshe nges 'byung dgos gsungs pas/ /rab byung gsar bu thams cad dang*/ khyim pa bsnyen gnas blangs kun la/ /nges 'byung skyes pa yin nam ci/ /min na sdom pa ji ltar skye/ /yin na nges 'byung gsung rab nas/ /bshad bzhin kun la 'bad med par/ /skye bar thal phyir 'dod pa min/ /gal te nges 'byung phal pa tsam/ /skye bar 'gyur gyi khyad par can/ /skye bar nges pa min zhe na/ /'dir yang rgyud sde nas bshad ltar/ /sems bskyed mtshan nyid rdzogs pa zhig /skye bar nges pa ma yin yang*/ /sangs rgyas don gnyer gyis zin pa'i/ /sems bskyed phal pa tsam zhig ni/ /skye ba yod phyir des kyang

'grub/ /mdor na snyigs dus mdo rgyud nas/ /bshad bzhin sa lam khyad par can/ /skye bar dka' zhing dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa de ltar bsrung dka' yang*/ /dus dang gnas skabs las dpag pa'i/ /srung sdom yod phyir sa lam kyang*/ /de dang mthun par skye bar mchis/ /gal te gsang sngags lam nyid nas/ /bshad ltar tshe 'dir sangs rgyas nyid/ /mi 'grub snyam na tshe 'di la/ /sangs rgyas 'grub par ma gyur kyang*/ /sngags kyi lha yi rnal 'byor la/ / bag chags khyad par can bzhag pas/ /lhag pa'i lha yis tshe rabs kun/ /rjes 'dzin byin rlabs rgyud smin te/ /skye ba bcu drug dag la sogs/ /myur du 'tshang rgya'i rten 'brel yod/ /dam tshig nyams na ngan 'gro ru/ /skye bar gsungs kyang bshags sdom dang*/ /lha yi rnal 'byor bzlas pa'i mthus/ /ngan 'gror skye ba 'gog pa yin/ /slob dpon rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /snying nas smod pa'i rtsa ltung 'di/ /ma gtogs rtsa ltung gzhan byung yang*/ /bshags sdom rnal 'byor stobs kyis ni/ /'dags par sla ba nyid bshad cing*/ /spyir ni rtsa ltung gang byung yang*/ /dbang gis sbyong bar gsungs pa lags/ /gsang sngags lam 'dir ma zhugs pa/ /bde 'gror skyes kyang skal ngan du/ /gsungs phyir lam 'dir zhugs pa ni/ /ngan 'gror skyes kyang skal ldan no/ /dper na mdo las zab mo'i don/ /ma thos ngan 'gror bskal pa'i bar/ /gnas 'gyur kha cig zab don nyid/ /thos nas skur ba btab gyur te/ /ngan 'gror skyes kyang myur bar ni/ /thar nas bde 'gror skye ba dang*/ /dgra bcom go 'phang thob bshad bzhin/ /sngags kyi dam tshig sdom pa nyid/ /nyams pa lta ci so thar gyi/ /sdom pa nyams par gyur pa yis/ /ngan 'gror skye bar bshad pa dang*/ /mi dge bcu dang mtshams med sogs/ /nyes pas ngan 'gror skye bar bshad/ /gal te nyes pa de re res/ /ngan 'gror skye bar ma nges kyang*/ /skye ba'i rgyu tsam la dgongs nas/

gsungs so zhe na 'dir yang mtshungs/ /spyir ni mdo sngags gzhung rnams las/ skyon dang yon tan gang la yang*/ /'di dang 'di ni byas pa las/ /phan yon nyes dmigs 'di dang 'di/ /'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa/ /dgongs gzhi gang la dgongs gyur ba'i/ /tshul de rtogs dka' ji ltar yang*/ /da lta'i gang zag dag la ni/ /ji bzhin 'byung ba'i nges pa med/ /mdor na dal rten thob dus 'dir/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lam spyi dang*/ /bla med lam du 'jug bya zhing*/ /gsang bde 'jigs gsum la sogs pa/ /gang la dga' ba de la 'bad/ /'on kyang rje yi dgongs pa ni/ /gsang bde 'jigs gsum 'brail bar ni/ /nyams su len pa nyid yin te/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog du ma yis/ /byin gyis rlob dang rjes 'dzin pa'i/ /rten 'brel yod pas gnad du che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gtsor gyur pa'i/ /lha mchog 'di dag thams cad kyi/ /mtshan tsam bzung bas ngan 'gro'i rgyu/ /sbyong na rnal 'byor bsgoms lta ci/ /skye ba brgya phrag dag tu yang*/ /ming tsam thos par dka' gyur na/ /thos bsam sgom pas 'jug byed pa/ /skal par ldan pa lta ci smos/ /de phyir dgag bya dgos pa ni/ /gnyis las dgos pa don gnyer ba/ /mchog tu bzung bya phyogs tsam zhig /rtogs pa'i blo ngan lam mi 'jug /gzhan du mdo dang rgyud sde las/ /gsungs pa ji bzhin lag len du/ /mi khel mthong nas 'dor byed na/ /rab byung byed pa nas bzung ste/ /thams cad sngon gyi dus lta bur/ /mi 'byung kun kyang 'dor dgos par/ /thal phyir bstan la'ang 'jug dka' bas/ /kun la log lta'i skur 'debs kyis/ /thar med ngan song cis mi 'phen/ /mkhas pas bstan la lung rigs kyis/ /byi dor dag ther byed pa'i tshe/ /dgos pa'i dbang gis gsungs pa ni/ /dgongs pa can te brtag bya'i gnas/ /deng dus gsang sngags bstan pa dang*/ /dam rdzas sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ /thams cad phyogs mthar khyab pa'i phyir/

/gsang dang mi gsang dbye ba ni/ /mtha' gcig tu ni nges pa ru/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang bsgrub mi nus/ /de phyir dus dang gnas skabs dang*/ /bstun pa'i chos lugs shes bya ste/ /sngon dang da lta ma 'ongs pa'i/ /bya byed gcig tu 'ongs dgos par/ /'dod la 'thad pa ga la yod/ /thub dbang rdo rje 'chang nyid kyis/ /'das dang da lta ma 'ongs pa'i/ /gdul bya'i mchog dman ma gzigs par/ /gsang sngags gsungs pa ma yin zhing*/ /paṇa grub rnams dang 'jam dbyangs dang*/ /rjes kyang ma 'ongs ma mkhyen min/ /sngon tshe dgra bcom grub chen sogs/ /mang byon da lta srid mtha' tsam/ /gyur 'di dus kyi dbang las te/ /des na gzhan du bsam mi bya/ /spyir ni ngan song las thar phyir/ /stobs bzhi'i bshags sdom byed pa ste/ /sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags tshogs kyi/ /mtshan nas gus pas brjod pa dang*/ /gzungs sngags khyad can rnams 'don cing*/ /bdag med don la dpyad par rigs/ /'khor ba las kyang grol ba'i thabs/ /de rnams 'gyur mod khyad par du/ /bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba ni/ /grol byed lam mchog dngos nyid du/ /bshad phyir thar 'dod nges 'byung kyang*/ /smin byed lam du 'gyur ba yin/ /mi rtag la sogs bcu drug ni/ /thar 'dod kun gyis bsam bya ste/ /nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa dang*/ /bdag med nyid du rab bshad de/ /skye 'jig phyir na mi rtag dang*/ /sdug bden nyid phyir sdug bsngal lo/ /don gzhan nyid kyis stong pa dang*/ /rang gi ngo bo bdag med bsam/ /sred sogs nyon mongs thams cad ni/ /sdug bsngal bskyed phyir rgyu yin la/ /sdug bsngal rnams 'byung kun 'byung ste/ /sdug bsngal rab skye rab skye dang*/ /sdug bsngal rkyen byed rkyen du brjod/ /sdug bsngal 'gag phyir 'gog pa ste/ /de nyid zhi phyir zhi ba dang*/ /gya nom nges 'byung zhes su'ang brjod/ /thar par bgrod byed lam nyid de/

/tshul bzhin sgrub byed sgrub pa dang*/ /gnyen po yin phyir rig pa ste/ /nges 'byin zhes kyang rab tu brjod/ /'dus byas thams cad mi rtag cing*/ /zag bcas thams cad sdug bden te/ /chos rnams thams cad bdag med dang*/ /mya ngan 'das pa zhi bar bsam/ /de ni chos kyi sdom zhes bya/ /don rigs bka' dang bstan bcos rnams/ /zhal 'don byed pa mchog yin mod/ /nges 'byung byams pa snying rje dang*/ /byang sems bdag med lta ba dang*/ /bslab gsum rim gnyis lam dag la/ /bslab la brtson pa ches mchog ste/ /gzhan du chos 'don pa ru 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis thar 'dod la/ /dben gnas mchog tu gsungs mod kyang*/ /de ni rnam g.yeng mi che bar/ /nyams len 'bad la dgongs pa ste/ /gzhan du ri dwags du ma dang*/ /bya byis 'bu srin mang po yang*/ /dben par ri khrod mi gnas sam/ khyad par byang chub sems dpa' la/ /nang gi dben pa mchog yin te/ /de yang rang don yid byed dang*/ /bral nas gzhan don gtsor sems pa/ /nang gi dben pa mchog tu bshad/ /rang don kho na yid byed bzhin/ /dben par lo ni bye ba brgyar/ /gnas kyang byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /dbang byas dben par legs gnas min/ /de yang so so skye bo la/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'dres pa las/ /gzhan don lo na 'byung dka' yang*/ /gzhan don yal bar dor nas ni/ /dge la ji ltar 'bad gyur kyang*/ /bde 'gro tsam mam nyan rang gi /lam las 'das pa ma yin no/ /de phyir rim gro rkyen sel sogs/ /rang gi don la gtsor dmigs pa'i/ /dge ba dag kyang gzhan don du/ /bsngo smon nyid kyis rgyas 'debs bya/ /rdzogs byang don gnyer bral ba dang*/ /gzhan phan blo ni med gyur pa/ /theg chen lam gyi snod min na/ /gsang sngags snod du 'gyur bar dka'/ /zhe sdang rnam kun sdig che zhing*/ /'dod chags las ni che sogs gsum/ /de yang 'dod chags dbang nyid kyis/ /phan gnod gnyis ka byed 'gyur yang*/

/kun gyi mig bltos la gnod pa'i/ /'dod chags rnam smin sdig che la/ /gzhan du nges pa med par gsungs/ /gti mug 'dod sdang rtsa ba ste/ /de las nyon mongs gzhan skye 'gyur/ /nyon mongs dbang gis las bsags te/ /las kyi dbang gis skye ba 'phen/ kha cig 'phangs 'bras rdzogs par byed/ /las nyon dbang gis skye zhes pa'i/ /nyon mongs gtso bo ma rig pa/ /las la dge sdig gnyis yod kyang*/ /gnyis ka 'du byed las su 'dus/ /ma rig dbang gis las dge sdig /bsags nas bde 'gro ngan 'gro ru/ /'phen la las nyon dbang gis na/ /'khor bar 'phen pa zhes ni brjod/ /de la 'dod khams gzugs khams dang*/ /gzugs med dag tu 'phen pa'ang yod/ /so skye bde ba can la sogs/ /dag pa'i zhing du skye ba ni/ kha cig las nyon dbang zer yang*/ /thabs dang smon lam bsod nams kyis/ /'phangs zhes brjod na legs par 'gyur/ /las kyi 'bras bu smin pa'i dus/ /go rim nges pa nyid min te/ /dbyig gnyen zhabs kyis mdzod 'grel las/ /las kyis 'khor bar lci gang dang*/ /nye ba gang dang goms pa gang*/ /sngon byas gang yin de dag las/ /snga ma snga ma rnam smin 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar du dge sdig gang*/ /che ba dag dang 'chi dus su/ /mngon du gyur pa gang yin dang*/ /goms pa shugs can gyur pa dang*/ /sngon du byas pa de dag gi /rnam smin rim par smin pa'am/ gang yang rung ba sngon la smin/ /lus can rnams kyi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la babs pa na/ /'bras bu smin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /'on kyang mi dge'i las phal cher/ /bshags pa la sogs gnyen po yis/ /rnam smin 'byin par 'gyur min zhing*/ /zag med las la'ang rnam smin med/ /nyon mongs rtsad nas spangs pa'i tshe/ /sngon byas zag bcas las dag ni/ /ci tsam yod kyang rnam smin gyi/ /'bras bu 'byin par mi nus te/ /dper na gsher dang bral gyur pa'i/ /sa bon skam gyis myu gu ni/

/sngon po 'byin par mi 'gyur bzhin/ /de phyir las nyon gnyis las ni/ /nyon mongs spong ba don che yang*/ /dang po'i las can dag la ni/ /las sgrib sbyong ba gnad du che/ khong khros rnam smin gtan bcom pa'i/ /dge ba'i las kyi rnam smin kyang*/ /mi 'grub de tshe las de rnams/ /lung ma bstan gi las dang mtshungs/ /rku 'phrog sogs kyis tshe 'di ru/ /'byor pa'i mnga' thang thob srid kyang*/ /de ni 'phral rkyen skyes bu yi/ /byed 'bras yin gyi rnam smin min/ /de bzhin sbyin btang tshe 'di ru/ / dbul dang chos byed 'di nyid du/ /sdug bsngal thob pa'ang srid mod kyi/ /'phral rkyen yin gyi rnam smin min/ /ji skad bshad pa des mtshon nas/ /sngon gyi las dang 'bral rkyen gyi/ /'bras bu'i khyad par phyed bya yi/ /gcig tu 'khrul par mi bya'o/ /las 'bras khyad par mi shes sam/ /shes kyang khyad gsod mi bya ste/ /ngan song gsum dang khyad par du/ /mngon mthong sdig sbrul sbal pa dang*/ /'bu srin la sogs mi sdug pa'i/ /gzugs can 'di 'drar 'gyur du srid/ /mdor na sdig spong dge ba'i las/ /ci nus bsgrub bya dge sdig gi /rnam smin bde sdug ma 'khrul par/ /'byung ba rten 'brel chos nyid yin/ /dper na gro nas sran ma sogs/ /sa bon sna tshogs bsres btab kyang*/ /rang rang 'bras bu ma nor bar/ /'byung gi nor nas 'byung mi srid/ /de bzhin phyi yi dngos kun gyi/ /'bras bu so sor mi 'khrul bar/ /'byung ba mngon sum mthong ba bzhin/ /de ltar shes pa'i lta ba ni/ /'jig rten pa yi yang dag lta/ /mi gang su la yod gyur pa/ /de ni bskal pa stong rnams su/ /ngan 'gror 'gro bar mi 'gyur bshad/ /tshul 'di rnam dpyod ldan pa'i ri khrod pa/ /kun dga' nor bus nyams len la mkho ba'i/ /yi ge 'di ltar gyis zhes nan tan du/ /bskul tshe bshad sgrub ming can nyid kyis sbyar/
/de yang tshig sbyor legs mi legs/ /bltos pa med par blo ngo la/ /gang shar thogs med myur bris pas/ /nor 'khrul mkhas la bzod par gsol/ /maṅga laṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/nyams len spyi la nye bar mkho ba'i dogs dpyod som nyi sel byed bzhugs/ -PAGE 384--PAGE 383--PAGE 372-
